environment: Qt offscreen, application fonts and light QSS, installed metrology-workspace environment
method: Each trial changes all 21 plots to a 20 nm wavelength interval centred at 520, 530, 540, 550, 560 and 570 nm. Timings include Qt event processing and painting. The full-data reference disables clipping on the same renderer. Each command uses a fresh process. Timings are fixture and environment dependent.

equivalence.dense_edge_case: An additional 50001-sample oscillatory curve with a 5 px selected stroke matches the full-data image byte for byte at the viewport edges.
equivalence.source_integrity: Focused tests preserve source arrays, NaN gaps and full-data auto-range bounds. Selection continues to use original CurveGroup segments.

rendering_policy: Full view retains every original sample. Zooming clips each individual spectrum with stroke-width overscan and neighbouring samples. No averaging, interpolation or downsampling is applied.
